clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken agents move against the Scourge on Fenris Isle. High Executor Hadrec sends them to storm Fenris Keep and take the head of Thule Ravenclaw, the necromancer commanding the island stronghold in Lake Lordamere.

The Forsaken hold the western roads and have established their presence at the Sepulcher, but the Scourge remain entrenched in Fenris Keep. The island lies in Lake Lordamere, east of Silverpine Forest, and its forces threaten the forest and the southern waterways leading toward the Undercity. High Executor Hadrec sees Thule Ravenclaw’s vile experiments as a danger to Forsaken control of Silverpine. Thule commands the Scourge from the keep, keeping their power close to the Forsaken shore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now is the time to assault the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine: Fenris Isle.
You must again go to the Isle and destroy Thule Ravenclaw. I want his head!
This mission is as dangerous as it is vital, friend. You must not fail.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Scourge cannot be allowed to remain in Silverpine, friend. Come back to me when you have proof of Thule's death.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The death of Thule Ravenclaw was no small event, friend. Renferrel tells me that the energies released when you destroyed Thule were felt even as far as the Sepulcher.
Your actions ring through the ranks of the Forsaken. Your value to us grows.
